customer_updates.name: MJ Studio
customer_updates.text:
One of the beautiful place so close to Mumbai, only 47 km drive  , Tungareshwar
Here are 5 simple one-liner points about Tungareshwar Temple Vasai:
* Ancient Shiva temple nestled in the Tungareshwar hills.
* Believed to be a site where Lord Shiva defeated demon Tunga.
* A popular pilgrimage spot, especially during Maha Shivratri.
* Located within a serene wildlife sanctuary offering natural beauty.
* Attracts devotees and trekkers seeking spiritual solace and nature.

featured_reviews.name: bhushan sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tungareshwar Temple is a perfect place for those seeking peace, spirituality, and a bit of adventure. Located amidst lush greenery and hills, the journey to the temple itself feels refreshing and calming. The scenic route, especially during monsoon, is absolutely beautiful.
The temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva, and the atmosphere is very serene and positive. It’s not just a temple visit but also a short trek, which makes the experience even more special. You’ll find small waterfalls and natural streams along the way, adding to the charm.
There are also food stalls offering simple and tasty local snacks, which is very convenient for visitors. The overall environment is clean, and the vibe is very devotional.
Tips:
Best time to visit is early morning or during monsoon season
Wear comfortable shoes as there is some walking involved
Carry water and essentials
Overall, it’s a must-visit place near Mumbai for nature lovers and devotees alike. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Neha Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: It is such a divine place . It's very peaceful there temple surrounded by nature it just too good. I would recommend to visit there in monsoon because you will see rivers, waterfalls etc, but in summers it's just to difficult to track to the temple specially when you are on fast .

featured_reviews.name: Ranjan Dwivedi
featured_reviews.review_text: Wonderful place for having calm and place with rejuvenating effect. Worship Mahadev Ji without any hassle. Place has an aura of calmness with beautiful and lush greenery of hills. Adventurous way to visit while you travel which seems a bit like you are trekking.

featured_reviews.name: Ramya Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a very beautiful temple in Sativali, Vasai east. This is a very beautiful temple dedicated to Shiv ji. It is believed that this temple is in existence since Bhagwan Parshuram's tie=me, means its more than 10,000 yrs old.
The temple is located in the middle of a dense jungle-as seen in its background. There are leopard spotting in this place, so it is good to take a share cab/taxi from the foothills of the temple to the entrance of the temple. Share taxi is Rs. 50/-. There are many monkeys in the premises-take care of phones, wallets and specs. But, the monkeys are harmless, they mind their own business. You can find monkeys inside the main sanctum as well. You can choose to feed bananas to them. The temple has a Hanuman temple and devi temple in the same compound. Also, there is a baba ashram on the foothills of the temple and one more baba ashram outside of the temple premises.
Outside the temple, there is a small garden for kids. There is a canteen/dhaba outside the temple. They serve delicious wadapav and pohe at an affordable price.

How to reach?
1. Get down at Vasai station and exit at east side
2. take an auto to Tungareshwar foothills. The auto will charge Rs.200 till the foothills. You can take the same auto till the main temple entrance but the auto will charge Rs.800 for pick and drop+the waiting time.
3. After reaching the foothills, take a share cab (Rs. 50 per person), the cab will wait for you if you tell him to do so. After u return, the same cab will drop u till the foothill again.

featured_reviews.name: Shivam Maurya
featured_reviews.review_text:
More fun in rainy season,I visited Tungareshwar Temple and had a peaceful experience. The temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva, is surrounded by beautiful hills and greenery, creating a calm and spiritual atmosphere. I performed puja and felt very positive vibes. After darshan, I enjoyed the nearby waterfall. The cool, fresh water and natural surroundings made the visit even more refreshing and fun.

If you plan to go, visit with at least two or more people since it’s inside a forest area. If you want to bathe in the waterfall, boys should carry an extra pair of clothes for convenience.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited the beautiful Shri Badrinath Mandir at UMM Vasai. A newly opened temple and such a peaceful place to visit with family. The temple is a stunning replica of the original Shri Badrinath Temple and gives a truly divine feeling.

I couldn’t manage to visit the actual Shri Badrinath Mandir, but I felt blessed to get darshan here in Vasai itself. The atmosphere is calm, spiritual, and very well maintained.

A small suggestion for visitors — please follow the dress code, and note that the temple remains closed for some time in the afternoon.

Definitely a must-visit place in Vasai for devotees and families. 🙏✨

featured_reviews.review_text: A newly constructed temple of Shri Vishnu in the form of Badrinath is truly beautiful and captivating. The temple has been built with great care and detail, reflecting the divine presence of Lord Vishnu. Its design and structure remind devotees of the sacred Badrinath temple, creating a peaceful and spiritual atmosphere. Anyone who visits the temple feels a deep sense of calm, devotion, and admiration for its beauty.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Shorewala
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Shri Badrinath Mandir in Vasai, and it was a truly peaceful and spiritually uplifting experience.

The temple is beautifully maintained, with a calm and divine atmosphere that makes it perfect for prayer and quiet reflection.

The idol of Lord Badrinath is very serene and grateful (आकर्षक), and the overall surroundings are clean and well-organized. The temple premises feels positive and welcoming, making it a great place to spend some clam time away from the noise of daily life.

The temple is open from 08:00 Am To 01:00 Pm and reopens at 04:00 Pm To 09:00 Pm.

The temple remain close in afternoon from 01:00 Pm to 04:00 Pm.

The temple also has lift facility for senior person which directly take you inside the temple. The access for the lift is from left hand side behind the stairs.

The temple can be easily accessible by auto, taxi and cars. Ample of parking place is available near temple.

Whether you are a regular devotee or just visiting for the first time, this temple offers a sense of inner peace and devotion.

Highly recommended for anyone seeking spiritual solace in Vasai.

featured_reviews.name: alka gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently had the opportunity to visit the replica of the Badrinath Temple located in Vasai, and the overall experience was truly enriching. The architecture and ambience successfully capture the essence of the original shrine, offering devotees a sense of devotion and reverence without undertaking the long pilgrimage. The atmosphere was peaceful, and it was heartening to witness numerous devotees immersed in prayer, reflecting the strong spiritual impact the temple has on visitors.

The sanctity of the premises and the devotion displayed by the attendees created a memorable and uplifting environment. It is evident that considerable effort has been made to preserve the traditional aesthetics and cultural significance of the temple, which deserves appreciation.

However, to further elevate the spiritual energy of the space, it would be beneficial to introduce continuous devotional music or bhajans in the background. A gentle, uninterrupted flow of sacred hymns would deepen the meditative atmosphere and help visitors feel more connected to the divine. Enhancing this auditory element would also contribute to a heightened sense of purity and tranquility within the temple precincts.

In conclusion, the replica Badrinath Temple in Vasai is a commendable initiative that allows devotees to experience spiritual solace closer to home. With minor enhancements to the auditory ambiance, it has the potential to become an even more powerful center of devotion and inner peace.

featured_reviews.name: Vanashree Vanmali
featured_reviews.review_text:
You should definitely visit this Complex of 3-4 Temples.
The construction is very old and hence gives the sense of purity and peace when visited on weekdays when there is not much rush of the devotees around or in the temple.
If you plan to visit this place, try going without a company or just +1 if you must.
Visit the temple early in the morning or at night by 8 o clock.
I prefer to go post 7:30PM & till 9 PM since the temple and the surrounding area (Vasai village) feels silent & yet very lively.

(Note: On weekdays the main entrance of the temple is closed post ~7 PM, but there are 3 other entrances adjacent to the main entrance, on the left and right, please enter through those. Also, maintain silence.)

featured_reviews.review_text: Experience is asked from visitors and tourists. Shani Mandir... My Vasai....it runs in my veins. It was a book; and now I'm an author of one myself. I just realised , Life has come full circle for me. This tradition has long ended. But Shani Mandir... it's a feeling, an emotion...far more valuable than an experience...
